description: CIRAD, ISRA and partners surveyed 310 farmers in irrigated production zones around Lake Guiers, northern Senegal, from 9 to 20 March 2023. The named CIRAD Dataverse release describes crop systems, pesticide and fertiliser use, farm conditions, perceived climate and pest pressures, and agroecological practices. Its file inventory contains English and French CSV data, codebook CSV files and questionnaires. All six files are marked unrestricted and the licence is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so the listed release is free with non-commercial and share-alike conditions. Coverage is a selected cross-sectional sample around one lake, not a national census or a farm panel. Limitations include recall, respondent selection and local institutional conditions, which can affect model transfer; no respondent-level value was inspected. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is parameterising farm-adoption or irrigation-management agents. model-fao-cropwat is a related irrigation-requirement model, without a verified direct import. The repository also shows placeholder access-terms text that conflicts with its unrestricted file flags; file retrieval was not tested.
